explanations.A: Correct. The maximum occurs at the vertex $(3,6)$ yielding $P=3(3)+4(6)=9+24=33$.
explanations.B: Incorrect. This would be the profit if one ignored the constraint $|x-y|\\le 3$ and took the point $(2,8)$, but that point violates $|2-8|=6>3$.
explanations.C: Incorrect. This might come from a miscalculation at the optimum, e.g., computing $3\\times3=6$ instead of $9$, giving $6+24=30$.
explanations.D: Incorrect. This is the sum $x+y$ at the optimum $(3,6)$, not the profit $3x+4y$.
explanations.E: Incorrect. This results from mistakenly assuming $x=y$ and solving $2x+x=12$ to get $x=4$, $y=4$, giving $P=3(4)+4(4)=28$.
